answer.reason: The verses tell two events of Eliab's own: the LORD refused him when Samuel looked on him, and he was angry with David at the battle.

clauses.english: was refused by the LORD when Samuel took him for the anointed
was angry with David and accused him of pride at the battle
clauses.quote: Eliab's anger was kindled against David

doubts: 1CH 27:18 names Elihu, a brother of David, not Eliab; it may be another name or person, so it was left out.
His going to the battle with Saul (1SA 17:13) and his daughter Abihail (2CH 11:18) were left out as minor or already in the summary.
